findings.claim: The dependency @nestjs/serve-static 5.0.5 still declares a peer range of ^8.0.4 || ^9.0.0 for @fastify/static, which the installed @fastify/static 10.1.3 does not satisfy; since ServeStaticModule is used in src/app.module.ts, this pre-existing peer mismatch remains unresolved, though it was not introduced by this PR.

@fastify/cookie is pinned with a caret range (^11.1.1) instead of an exact version, which is an exception to the convention that runtime dependencies be pinned exactly; it is unchanged by this diff but could be addressed as a follow-up.

@fastify/static is pinned with a caret range (^10.1.3) instead of an exact version, which is an exception to the convention that runtime dependencies be pinned exactly; it is unchanged by this diff but could be addressed as a follow-up.

The commit body's phrase 'lift the transitive resolutions' could be misread as adding Yarn resolutions entries, when in fact no resolutions were added and the upgrades are lockfile-only changes within existing semver ranges; if this text is reused as the PR body, wording such as 're-resolve transitive dependencies in yarn.lock' would state it more clearly.
